adopted_by: owner choice, not by the original rule
recal_choice: lower walk-forward log loss on test weeks (2026 week 3 onward); tie goes to logistic
collapse: one lean per (game, player, stat): the strike with the largest absolute edge among strikes at or over the threshold
design_effect: 1 + (mean leans per game - 1) * ICC of per-lean realized edge within game, ICC floored at 0
need_corrected: base need for 2 point edge at 80% power times design effect

price_modes.exec: over bought at ask90; under bought at 1 - bid90; both need bid and ask present, ask above bid, and the liquid90 flag

fee: 0.07 * p * (1 - p) per contract at the price paid (Kalshi taker formula from secondary sources; single-contract orders round up to the cent so true cost is a little higher)
clv_exec: over: bidC - ask90; under: bid90 - askC

placebo.method: within each game and stat, shuffle model-minus-market differences across rows, rebuild model chance as market plus shuffled difference, clipped to 0.01 to 0.99

subgroups.correction: Holm over all subgroup tests in those families; one-sided bootstrap p for realized edge after costs above zero; weeks are descriptive only
